title: Culture-Aware Machine Translation in Large Language Models: Benchmarking and Investigation
reasoning: The paper evaluates religion and moral values as core components of its culture-aware translation benchmark. Specifically, the 'Social culture and customs' category in the CanMT dataset includes religion, mythology, and taboos. The investigation also provides case studies on how models handle religious prayers and moralized content (e.g., 'immoral' descriptions) across cultural boundaries.
